items.title: 4.7.1 Limiting reactant ki pehchan ki hikmat-e-amali (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7.1, printed pages 86-87.

items: Reactants ki di gai miqdaron se moles ki tadaad nikalein.
Balanced muadle se maloom karein ke har ek kitna product dega.
Jo reactant sab se kam product de woh limiting reactant hai; doosra excess reactant.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Aag ek combustion reaction hai jis mein fuel aur oxygen, aam taur par zyada darja hararat par, mil kar pani aur carbon dioxide banate hain; shuru hone ke baad yeh khud ko qaim rakhti hai. Dhanpna (smothering) dastiyab oxygen ko darkar sath se neeche kar ke aag bujhata hai, yani excess reactant ki miqdar ghatata hai. Foams, inert gas aur CO2 dhanpne ke liye moassar hain.

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 4.17: NH3 aur CuO se N2, 2NH3 + 3CuO = N2 + 3Cu + 3H2O
rows: Har ek kitna N2 de sakta hai

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 4.18: 1.25 dm3 0.05 mol/dm3 Pb(NO3)2 aur 2.00 dm3 0.025 mol/dm3 Na2SO4 se PbSO4

blocks.title: Print ki jaanch
blocks.text: Sample 4.17 sawal mein NH3 ka mass 1.81 g aur hal mein 18.1 g deta hai (18.1 g se 1.06 mol), aur N2 ke moles ko N2 ke molar mass 28.0 ke bajaye 17.0 se zarb de kar 9.0 g chhapta hai; 28.0 se mass 10.6 g hai.

blocks.prompt: N2 + 3H2 = 2NH3 se kaun sa mixture sab se zyada NH3 deta hai: (a) 1 mol N2 aur 3 mol H2, (b) 2 mol N2 aur 3 mol H2, (c) 1 mol N2 aur 5 mol H2, (d) 3 mol N2 aur 3 mol H2?
blocks.explanation: Har ek mein limiting reactant nikalein. (a) theek tanasub: 2 mol NH3. (b) H2 mehdood karta hai: 3 mol H2 se 2 mol NH3. (c) N2 mehdood karta hai: 1 mol N2 se 2 mol NH3. (d) H2 mehdood karta hai: 2 mol NH3. Har mixture wahi 2 mol product deta hai.

items: Teen qadam: har reactant ke moles; muadle se har ek ka product; sab se kam dene wala limiting hai. Sample 4.17 mein CuO limiting (0.38 mol N2); Sample 4.18 mein sulfate limiting (0.05 mol, 15.2 g PbSO4).
